fields.title: Upgrade pinned Rust and package minimums to 1.100.0

data.text: Updated Rust pin, all 22 package minimums, CI, detached portability gate and generated consumer manifests to 1.100.0. Initial verify found eight new Clippy map_unwrap_or errors; applied equivalent map_or_default fixes in native memory stores without weakening checks. Standalone at-rest portability gate passed on macOS arm64. Full verification rerun in progress.

Verification on macOS arm64 / rustc 1.100.0 (0ef1bc386): scripts/verify.sh passed formatting, file budgets, all four Clippy configurations and all six matrix parts, then stopped at new rustdoc redundant_explicit_links warning. Corrected two cookie-helper links; reran strict workspace rustdoc and all HTTP smoke profiles successfully. Final fmt and file-budget checks passed. Standalone at-rest portability gate passed. Matrix not repeated after documentation-only fix. Cargo.lock unchanged. Linux and hosted CI not executed locally; no public API shape changes.

data.reason: Upgraded Rust pin and all package minimums to 1.100.0; updated CI and consumers, repaired compiler lint/doc issues, completed local verification and delivered PR.
